status: DRAFT for owner review. Not locked. No confirmation task has been generated or run.

owner_direction.decision_5: Draft and review B1 v5 before locking it. Make accuracy with examples present the primary gate, compare against matched compute, and include the valid-code guessing control.
owner_direction.decision_6: Pin the unseen Qwen checkpoint before downloading. Name the host, storage path, and exact revision. Reserve the model for confirmation.
owner_direction.reading_applied: Accuracy with examples present is the primary gate: the adapter runs with the table in the prompt, against the base model with the same prompt and against same-prompt baselines of equal or greater compute. Prompt removal is kept as a separate reported result. (As restated in the owner's status summary of 2026-11-18.)

claim: A support table can be compiled, in closed form and with no gradient step, into a low-rank update on the top two MLP layers of a frozen model such that, with the table still in the prompt, the model answers unseen questions more accurately than the unmodified model given the same prompt.

tasks.generator: tasks_v5.py, split 'confirm' (eight item groups never used in development)
tasks.confirmation_seed: to be drawn at lock time, >= 2000000
tasks.unit_of_analysis: the support table. Questions that share a table are not independent, so each table contributes one number per arm (its count of correct answers). Per model, never pooled across models.

arms.base_ctx: base model, table in the prompt
arms.top2_ctx: PRIMARY: fixed adapter, table in the prompt
arms.knn_ctx: matched compute: base model plus a nearest-neighbour cache over the table's own answers (one pass)
arms.cad_ctx: greater compute: base model with context-aware decoding (two passes per token)

PRIMARY_examples_present.comparison: top2_ctx against base_ctx, per model, over the tables of both settings
PRIMARY_examples_present.test: exact two-sided sign-flip permutation test on the per-table difference in correct answers (table_level_v5.py)

matched_compute.comparison: top2_ctx against knn_ctx and against cad_ctx, same test
matched_compute.pass: reported, with this rule fixed in advance: if top2_ctx does not beat knn_ctx, the write-up says the adapter has no examples-present advantage over a nearest-neighbour cache, whatever the primary gate shows
matched_compute.cost_accounting: seconds per question for every arm from the same run; the adapter's compile time per table measured with only the fixed adapter compiled (fixed_compile_ms) and its forward-pass count; questions that share a table share one compile

guessing_control.comparison: every arm's rate of valid codes; top2_bare against a rate of 0.25 (one of four valid codes)
guessing_control.pass: one-sided binomial p < 0.01 for top2_bare; valid-code rates reported for all arms

do_no_harm.pass: the table-level test does not show top2_ctx worse at 0.05

SECONDARY_prompt_removed.pass: top2_bare is within 5 points of base_ctx and the test does not show it worse at 0.05; time per question reported
SECONDARY_prompt_removed.known_gap: A cached copy of the prompt would give base_ctx accuracy at about base_bare time. That arm is not implemented (Doppler exposes prefix snapshots; the runner does not use them yet). Until it is, the timing advantage is against re-reading the prompt, and the adapter's case against a cache is size and freed context.

unseen_confirmation_model.status: NOT PINNED. Nothing is downloaded until the owner fills these in (decision 6).
unseen_confirmation_model.constraint: must add its MLP output straight to the residual stream; a Doppler Q4K build avoids porting the compiler to PyTorch

models.out_of_scope: gemma-3-270m-it (post-feedforward norm); its v4 failure stands as reported

frozen_at_lock: fixed adapter: top two layers, ridge 0.15, write strength 0.15 of the median final hidden RMS per layer; nearest-neighbour cache temperature 0.08 and strength 8.0; context-aware decoding beta 0.5; the selected adapter is not run
procedure: Two commits. Commit 1 locks this file with status LOCKED and the SHA-256 of the frozen files, before the confirmation seed is drawn. Commit 2 adds the receipts and the write-up. The confirmation runs once per model and setting.
development_evidence: RESULTS.md. Development runs are not confirmation; several seeds were looked at while the code changed.
secondary_result: With the table removed, the adapted model is not less accurate than the unmodified model with the table present, at lower time per question.
